Quickwit 0.8.2, self-hosted as a single Docker node on the benchmark host.
The index uses one positional, fieldnorm-enabled text field and stores only the external document ID.
Timed searches sort by BM25 score and return ranked document IDs over persistent HTTP connections.
Quickwit's default lowercase tokenizer has no configurable stop-word filter, so analyzer parity with Antfly is not exact.
